items.prompt: I’m going to show you how to write new fractions that are equivalent to a starting fraction. Let’s say we start with this fraction: 3/4 And we want to create new fraction with 20 on the bottom, like this; 3/4 ▢/20 My turn first to write the equation that will help us. We know we have to multiply top and bottom, by a new fraction equal to one, so we write this: 3/4 × ▢/▢ = ▢/20
items.demo: Three fourths, times by a fraction, is equal to *something over twenty*.
